leadership_and_planning: Appointed Technical Manager: assumed full engineering responsibility for all service-truck and bowser projects
Led a 19-person cross-functional team (2 draftsmen, 10 fitters, 5 welders, 2 procurement officers)
Owned project planning, supplier sourcing, client liaison and Excel-based scheduling from kick-off to final sign-off

Engineered and manufactured 60 % stronger load-bearing tank support structures (validated by FEA and real-world testing)
Introduced fully modular bolt-on enclosed pump compartments – now standard across the IFS fleet
structural_design: Completed intensive SolidWorks training (sheet-metal, welded structures, assemblies)
Redesigned chassis-to-tank mounting systems for higher dynamic loads and longer fatigue life
Created complete manufacturing drawing packages for all structural components
hydraulics_drive: Developed in-house Excel hydraulic motor/sprocket sizing calculator (motor cc, kW, flow, ratio → chain speed)
Specified and integrated hydraulic drive packages for reel, pump and compressor systems across all five vehicles

Designed, built and retrofitted the first Lumier PLC-based control system on a 17 000 L service truck for Vale Mozambique
Integrated proportional valve control, load-sense hydraulics and HMI interfaces
sales_and_customer_solutions: Worked directly with mining clients to translate operational requirements into technical specifications
Prepared detailed technical proposals and costing schedules that secured the 2013 orders
technical_training: Trained workshop teams on new modular designs, welding sequences and quality standards
Created assembly checklists and commissioning procedures still in use today
impact_and_results: Successfully delivered R 20 m+ worth of specialised vehicles on time and within budget
Achieved 60 % improvement in tank structural integrity (zero fatigue failures in service)
Established Lumier as the recognised automation brand for IFS in the coal and hard-rock mining sector
